scope: International newborn and maternal safety: targeted identity, outcome, shared-cohort, selected funding and article-applicability checks

records.findings: 200 mainly Māori women randomized to wahakura or bassinet; reported breastfeeding difference at six months, no significant difference in direct bedsharing. Not powered for rare sudden infant deaths.
records.cohort: Related physiological paper I1-B03-012 from same randomized cohort; do not count independently.
records.funding: Funding for shared trial reported in related paper: Health Research Council of New Zealand and University of Otago; this paper's own disclosures pending.
records.article_applicability: Infant safe sleep: contextual harm-reduction evidence only; no endorsement of unapproved sleep products or bedsharing.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.
records.scope: Indexed original-publication metadata/abstract, selected registry and publisher excerpts; no formal full-text risk-of-bias appraisal.

records.findings: Physiological monitoring of 167 infants (83 bassinet,84 wahakura); oxygenation, heart rate and temperature comparisons did not show significant differences. Short-term surrogate outcomes cannot establish mortality equivalence.
records.cohort: Same participants as I1-B03-011; authors explicitly identify behavioral publication.
records.funding: Health Research Council NZ grant 10/477 and University of Otago Research Grant reported; full COI and sponsor-role audit pending.
records.article_applicability: Infant safe sleep: no mortality or device certification claim.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.
records.scope: Indexed original-publication metadata/abstract, selected registry and publisher excerpts; no formal full-text risk-of-bias appraisal.

records.findings: BEEP UK HTA report of 1394 randomized infants: no preventive eczema benefit; skin infection adjusted incidence rate ratio 1.55 (95% CI 1.15–2.09). Unblinded families, contamination and differing products limit interpretation.
records.cohort: BEEP ISRCTN21528841; report is not independent replication of prior BEEP publications.
records.funding: NIHR HTA award 12/67/12; named branded products used; author relationships and supply terms require detailed review.
records.article_applicability: Newborn skin: distinguish eczema prevention in healthy high-risk infants from treatment of established eczema; retain adverse-event context.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.
records.scope: Indexed original-publication metadata/abstract, selected registry and publisher excerpts; no formal full-text risk-of-bias appraisal.

records.findings: PreventADALL factorial cluster trial: neither early food intervention nor skin emollient reduced atopic dermatitis in infancy; skin risk difference 3.1 percentage points (95% CI -0.3 to 6.5) in direction favoring control.
records.cohort: Same trial family as I1-B01-045 and PMID 35753340; different endpoints/ages, not independent samples.
records.funding: Multiple Norwegian and Swedish public, hospital, research and charitable funders reported; individual product supply, author ties and sponsor role unresolved.
records.article_applicability: Newborn skin and food allergy: do not equate eczema outcomes with food allergy outcomes.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.
records.scope: Indexed original-publication metadata/abstract, selected registry and publisher excerpts; no formal full-text risk-of-bias appraisal.

records.findings: Indexed abstract of seven-year PreventADALL follow-up: short early food intervention did not yield sustained food allergy prevention despite reduced sensitization. Direct page unavailable; indexed excerpt only.
records.cohort: Same PreventADALL trial as I1-B01-044 and PMID 35753340; verify follow-up attrition and arm denominators before extraction.
records.funding: Follow-up-specific funding, commercial relationships and sponsor role unresolved.
records.article_applicability: Allergy article: differentiate clinical allergy from sensitization and age-specific effects; no advice to stop established guidance.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.
records.scope: Indexed original-publication metadata/abstract, selected registry and publisher excerpts; no formal full-text risk-of-bias appraisal.

records.findings: Japan historical comparison 132 controls (2019) and 140 intervention (2020): no overall dermatitis difference at 6 or 12 months; winter-born subgroup favored intervention. Nonconcurrent groups, questionnaire outcome, season and pandemic-period confounding, multiplicity concerns.
records.cohort: Distinct design from 2019 factorial trial; overlap not established.
records.funding: Funding, product supply and author interests unresolved.
records.article_applicability: Newborn skin: subgroup exploratory, cannot justify universal prevention or specific product.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.
records.scope: Indexed original-publication metadata/abstract, selected registry and publisher excerpts; no formal full-text risk-of-bias appraisal.

records.findings: Japanese 2x2 randomized trial: indexed results report neither emollient nor synbiotic reduced dermatitis or food allergy at one year. Direct PubMed page access limited; registry confirms identity/design.
records.cohort: Registry record R000012665; independent relationship to other Chiba studies unresolved.
records.funding: Registry and author disclosures require detailed extraction; no independence conclusion.
records.article_applicability: Infant skin/allergy: no preventive supplement or emollient recommendation from this alone.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.

records.findings: Vietnam randomized trial, 50 per arm, 1500–2500 g newborns without life-threatening conditions; skin-to-skin improved six-hour physiological stability score. Small trial, surrogate primary endpoint.
records.cohort: Replication of earlier trial noted; exact prior cohort identity unresolved.
records.funding: Funding, author interests and sponsor role unresolved.
records.article_applicability: Newborn care: hospital-supervised skin-to-skin; not a substitute for medical stabilization, monitoring or resuscitation.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.

records.findings: China single-center randomized trial, 209 dyads, short-term feeding and temperature improvements after cesarean; abstract contains implausible gestational-age unit ('years old'), check table/erratum before numerical reuse.
records.cohort: Distinct recruitment period from PMID 37244638; formal overlap review pending.
records.funding: Funding/COI and registration analysis not completed.

records.findings: Kenyan placebo-controlled trial of 470 pregnant women in malaria-endemic area; infection risk at birth 50.9% vs 52.1%, risk difference -1.2 percentage points (95% CI -11.8 to 9.5); birthweight higher in iron arm. Wide interval does not prove absence of harm in all settings.
records.cohort: Check linked trial reports and thesis before pooled use.
records.funding: Funding, supply and commercial relationships unresolved.
records.article_applicability: Nutrition: context-specific antenatal iron evidence; not a reason for self-dosing or omitting malaria prevention.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.
records.scope: Indexed original-publication metadata/abstract, selected registry and publisher excerpts; no formal full-text risk-of-bias appraisal.

records.findings: Multicountry randomized noninferiority trial of active third-stage management with or without controlled cord traction. Indexed title and sponsor verified; full quantitative noninferiority appraisal not performed.
records.cohort: Trial family and registry linkage pending.
records.funding: USAID and UNDP/UNFPA/WHO/World Bank HRP program reported; funder role and COI pending.
records.article_applicability: Birth safety: clinician-led intervention only; no self-managed cord traction or hemorrhage protocol.

records.findings: Thai randomized screening trial reports higher GDM detection with one-step testing; no demonstrated difference in maternal/newborn outcomes in small sample. Abstract allocation (72/71) differs from reported result denominators (73/70); reconcile before graphing.
records.cohort: Single trial; registration and other reports pending.
records.funding: Funding and COI unresolved; PMC full-text access blocked during this check.
records.article_applicability: GDM screening: diagnostic yield is not proof of improved outcomes; do not alter local clinician screening protocols. Numerical denominator hold.
records.integrity: Correction/retraction search not completed; no clearance inferred.
